diagnostics_summary: Model shows severe overfitting (8% train-validation gap: 70.77% vs 62.90%). Validation metrics degraded vs baseline: accuracy -5.1% (68% → 63%), AUC -0.038 (0.733 → 0.694), Brier +0.005. 15+ near-zero importance features (<5) adding noise. Stance features contribute minimal predictive value. Top 25% currently at 79.19% accuracy with excellent calibration. Underdogs show 121% ROI on top 10% confidence but struggle in +150 to +250 band (44.4% accuracy). Model heavily weights striking volume control (top 2 features), age difference, and takedown ability.
avoid_constraints: Do NOT add new features involving quality differences.
hypotheses: Removing 15+ low-importance features will reduce overfitting and improve validation Top 25% accuracy by reducing noise in the model.
Increasing regularization will close the train-validation gap and improve generalization to Top 25% predictions.
Removing redundant individual features (keeping only diff versions) will streamline signal and improve both Top 25% and underdog performance.
Adding underdog-specific features (without quality differences) will improve the +150 to +250 odds band accuracy from 44.4%.
Model recalibration after feature pruning will improve probability estimates for Top 25% confidence predictions.

proposed_iterations.focus: Remove lowest importance stance and common opponent features
proposed_iterations.rationale: Diagnostics show southpaw_vs_southpaw (importance 1), orthodox_vs_orthodox (2), and num_common_opponents (1) have near-zero importance. Removing these noise features should reduce overfitting and improve Top 25% generalization.

Diagnostics identify f1_recent_finish_loss_ratio_last_2 (importance 2) and f2_recent_finish_loss_ratio_last_2 (4) as redundant since the diff version has importance 26. Keeping only the diff version reduces multicollinearity.
Diagnostics show f2_time_decayed_win_rate_adj_opp_quality has importance 2 while the diff version has 28. Remove individual F2 feature to reduce noise while keeping the differential signal.
Diagnostics show f2_recent_form_quality_adjusted (importance 3) is redundant with diff version (importance 24). Remove individual feature to streamline signal.
Diagnostics show f1_performance_trend (4) and f2_performance_trend (12) both have very low importance. These features add noise without meaningful predictive value for Top 25% predictions.

Diagnostics identify f1_sig_strikes_landed_per_min_lifetime (10) and f2_sig_strikes_landed_per_min_lifetime (4) as redundant. Recent versions are more predictive (importance 20 each). Keep recent, remove lifetime.
Diagnostics show f2_height_cm has importance 6 while reach_advantage has 24. Height signal is captured in reach advantage. Remove redundant height feature.
Diagnostics show f2_round_3_win_rate has importance 4. Round-specific metrics have low value and add noise. Remove to reduce overfitting.
Diagnostics show f2_age_x_fights_since_last_win has importance 5. Very low importance interaction feature adding noise to the model.
Diagnostics show style_volatility_mismatch_diff has importance 6 despite being a diff feature. Very low predictive value for Top 25% confidence predictions.

Diagnostics show 8% train-validation gap indicating overfitting. After pruning low-importance features in iterations 1-10, increase regularization to further reduce overfitting and improve Top 25% validation performance.

proposed_iterations.focus: Add underdog momentum feature for mid-range odds
proposed_iterations.rationale: Diagnostics show underdog accuracy drops to 44.4% in +150 to +250 odds band. Add a feature capturing fighter momentum when fighting as slight/medium underdog to improve predictions in this range.

Diagnostics identify mid-range underdogs (+150 to +250) as problematic. These are likely more competitive fights. Add interaction features that amplify signal when skill differentials are small (close matchups).

After removing 13+ low-importance features in iterations 1-10, recalibrate the model to improve probability estimates. Current Top 25% shows 79.19% accuracy - recalibration should push this higher by improving confidence calibration.
Diagnostics show overfitting with 8% accuracy gap. After feature pruning and regularization increase, reducing max_depth will further constrain model complexity and improve Top 25% generalization.
